name: Izanami Hifumi
source:
A host ranked No.1 in Shinjuku, who suffers from an extreme fear of women.
By putting on his jacket and "becoming a host," he’s able to face women directly. His personality changes drastically depending on whether he’s wearing the jacket, which sometimes surprises those around him.

He shares an apartment with his childhood friend Doppo, whom he’s known since elementary school, and takes full responsibility for cooking and household chores.

[spoiler]With help from his teammates, he confronted Jakouin Honobono, the former captain of the Chuo Police Bureau Special Forces unit “Kotodama” — the source of his trauma.
